entries.title: Twitch says GTA VI was its "largest game launch ever" with 3.3M concurrent livestream viewers; GTA VI is set to hit $3B+ in revenue in its first few months (Cecilia D'Anastasio/Bloomberg)
Temu owner PDD reports Q3 revenue flat YoY at ~$16.2B, below ~$17.3B est., and net profit up 0.7% to ~$4.43B, above ~$3.7B est., as Temu's user base shrinks (Tracy Qu/Wall Street Journal)
Canva adds a toggle to let free and paid users disable generative AI features like Magic Expand, following user frustration over the platform's AI push (Emma Roth/The Verge)
GTA VI's 5,000-strong team eschewed AI and procedural generation in favor of handcrafted "fidelity", with 30,000 unique NPCs and an in-game video game system (Joseph Bernstein/New York Times)
IEA expects global data center investment to hit $4T by 2030; fewer than 100 major AI projects would require a combined 50GW of power, matching peak UK demand (Will Mathis/Bloomberg)
Dustin Moskovitz, one of Anthropic's earliest investors, says he "invested in Anthropic to promote safety, not racing" and frontier AI labs "should slow down" (New York Times)
Analysis: Anthropic needs ~$602B in annual revenue to hit a 20% return on invested capital comparable to its Big Tech peers; Apple has $478B in annual revenue (Financial Times)
Germany and Austria submit a proposal urging the EU to require TikTok to find a local owner for its European operations to combat TikTok's ties to Beijing (Bloomberg)
Google is mandating Android app support for foldables starting in April 2027, saying developers must meet Tier 3 standards by filling display areas and more (Jay Peters/The Verge)
Snap launches Easy Lens CLI on Mac, Windows, and Linux, letting developers build AR Lenses using external AI coding tools like Claude Code (Aisha Malik/TechCrunch)
An argument against tech's "silent consensus", a belief that AI advances mean the forfeiture of human primacy, and a call for legal and technical frameworks (Dean Ball/OpenAI)
A look at Jeff Bezos' AI startup Prometheus, which raised $18B and employs ~250 people; sources say it is building an end-to-end agentic AI engineering system (Rebecca Heilweil/Fast Company)
Anthropic is set to become the US stock market's largest public benefit corporation by far; the mandate is overseen by a five-member "long-term benefit trust" (Cory Weinberg/New York Times)
Alibaba reports Q2 revenue up 10% to ~$40.7B, above est., and net profit up 3x to ~$9.68B, above ~$3.6B est., as its AI and e-commerce profitability improves (Tracy Qu/Wall Street Journal)
Sources: Moonshot AI cancelled a $150M contract with a Southeast Asian neocloud to rent access to Nvidia AI chips in an Indonesian data center, after US rules (The Information)
